proposal.title: Outward-facing choices
proposal.summary: Asks the owner to decide on releases, macOS and Windows code signing and the repository move, proposing that agents prepare releases the owner tags, archives ship unsigned, and the repository stays.

body.p: (; for the owner): tagging and publishing releases (0.2.0 and after, docs/RELEASE.md, the archives of mise run dist, ), macOS and Windows code signing, and when the repository moves to tinyactors-dev. The license (MIT) and the npm name (@tinyactors/sxml) are settled in . The proposed defaults, which hold until the owner decides:

item.p: Releases: agents prepare everything up to the tag (docs/RELEASE.md, ); nothing is tagged or published until the owner does it.

Signing: the archives ship unsigned, the arm64 macOS program signed ad hoc by zig, and README.md says how to lift macOS's quarantine (); Developer ID signing, notarization and Authenticode wait for the owner's certificates.
The repository stays where it is until the owner says it moves ().
